description: Routes one input to one of four outputs, choosing a new one at random on each trigger

params.text: Picks which of the four outputs is favoured, or uniform randomness for no favourite
Sets how often the favoured output is chosen, 0 to 100%; the rest of the time one of the other three is chosen

inputs.text: A trigger chooses a new output for the input
The signal routed to one of the four outputs, gates or voltages alike

outputs.text: Carries the input while this is the chosen output, and 0V while it is not

notes: with no cable in TRG the input itself does the choosing: it is read as a gate above 2V, and the chosen output puts out 10V
menu: Mode — Latch gives 10V only while the input gate is high, Toggle holds 10V until another output is chosen, with TRG unpatched; the two names are the wrong way round
